### 🚚 What changed

**Damage Reports has a new home.** The old history tab is now a full **Damage Reports** screen with **All** and **Mine** tabs, plus a bleacher filter, so you can see what's already been reported before you file something new.

- Tap **+** to start a report — you'll first see any open reports already on that bleacher, so you're not the third person reporting the same dent.
- See something already reported? Open it and tap **I saw this too** instead of filing a duplicate.
- Fixed something in the field? Open the report and mark it **Fixed** — right from your phone.
- During an inspection, if damage is found, you can now check off an existing open report instead of always starting a new form.

### 🆕 What's New — see everything we ship

Open the **menu** (top right) **→ What's New.** Every update to the app now gets
written up here, newest first, so you can see what changed instead of noticing a
button moved.

A blue dot sits on the menu button and on the **What's New** row whenever there
is an update you haven't read yet. Opening the page clears it.

The whole page works with **no signal** — the notes ship inside the app itself,
so you can read them from a yard, a loading dock, or the middle of nowhere.
